beats.say: Solve log base three of X minus eight equals two minus log base three of X.
The plan: get one log on each side, then compare what is inside.

do.text: Aim: one log each side, then compare

beats.say: Move minus log base three of X to the left. It becomes plus log base three of X.
Add Power joins the two logs: log of X times the bracket X minus eight.
Write two as log base three of nine. Three squared is nine.
One log on each side, so drop the logs and compare. X squared minus eight X minus nine equals zero.
Factorise. X minus nine, times X plus one, equals zero.
So X equals nine or X equals minus one.
Check every root in the logs. X equals minus one gives log of minus nine, so reject it.
The answer is X equals nine.
